summary: The no_valid_comparison closure stands. The authors tested rhythmicity within each diet. I found no published gene-level estimate of the registered HFD-minus-chow expression difference across matched sampling times. All 46 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and I reproduced all 14,644 registered coefficients. The corrected proposal documents 27 date-valued gene IDs per transcript workbook, incomplete lag and amplitude coverage, and different handling of duplicate GEO labels.
openIssues: Author agreement on the registered diet effect, P values and FDR remains unassessed.
The SI Appendix reports a HiSeq 2500, while GEO and ENA report a HiSeq 4000. Public records identify libraries and replicate labels but omit individual-animal identifiers.
